description: Cheaply map a memory TITLE or rule/skill NAME (the label you already see in the compiled knowledge / injected context) to its editing handle: `{ id, node_path, version_id }`. Use this BEFORE update_*/read_*/delete_* when you know WHAT to edit but not its id — do NOT pull the tree or read candidate bodies to hunt for the id. Reads only titles+ids to match. For a single unambiguous match it also returns `version_id` AND the full `content` (unless include_body:false), so a resolve+read collapses into ONE call — read it, then update_* with a `content_edit` delta. Pass `node_path` to disambiguate same-named items. Returns `{ matches: [...], unique }`.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory used to resolve the workspace when workspace_id is omitted.

include_body.description: For a single unambiguous match, also return its full `content` (default true — the row is read for version_id anyway, so the body is free). Set false to keep the response to just the handle.

kind.description: Restrict to one kind. Omit to search memories, rules, and skills.

node_path.description: Restrict to items attached at this workspace-relative path (e.g. '/packages/app'). Use to disambiguate a name that exists at multiple paths.

query.description: The memory title or rule/skill name to resolve (exact, prefix, or substring).

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID. Provide it if you already have it (from get_context); otherwise it resolves from cwd.

name: pathrule_resolve
title: Resolve Name to Edit Handle
